title: Very cute for decor!
text: Very cute for decor!. I love these! They are the exact color I was hoping for and are super cute. I bought these for decor only. I don’t think these are well suited for daily, functional use. More for looks and if that’s all you want these are perfect. Well made, good size range, spoons are added bonus and are wooden. Would buy again!
